relevance: A unique indexed chunk is relevant if its positive-length canonical unit spans overlap any unit in the union of all legal evidence reference sets.
ranking: BM25/Dense/Hybrid: raw_retrieval first10. HybridRerank: selected_retrieval actual reranked first10. No context expansion is ranked here.
mrr: Reciprocal rank of first relevant chunk within10; zero when absent.
ndcg: Binary gains at10, discount log2(rank+1); ideal DCG uses min(10, all relevant indexed chunks in declared scope), not just retrieved candidates.
failure_policy: Answerable failures remain zero; unanswerable evidence ranking is N/A.
use: Auxiliary descriptive analysis only; never candidate selection, context selection, or deployment gating.
limitations: Any positive overlap can be insufficient to answer. Overlapping chunks may each count as relevant. Grain and overlap change the relevant-item universe, so cross-chunking MRR/nDCG comparability is limited. Strict full-unit/full-reference coverage remains primary.
